title: Weight Averaging at Small Budgets Confounds Formula-Labeled Pretraining in Microstructure-Property Regression: A Pre-Specified Study with Post Hoc Rechecks
abstract: arXiv:2611.29876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Closed-form physics formulas can label synthetic microstructures at no cost, so supervised pretraining on those labels is an alternative to self-supervised pretraining when labels are scarce. One pre-specified protocol tests this on two public simulated benchmarks, two-phase conductivity and short-fiber stiffness: a ConvNeXt-Small is pretrained on 150,000 synthetic images by formula regression or masked reconstruction and fine-tuned on 100, 400, or 1,600 labels. Five fine-tuning seeds from one formula checkpoint have mean residual correlations of 0.994 (conductivity) and 0.999 (stiffness). On conductivity the formula network compresses its predictions (slope 0.64) and has four times the 400-label error of ImageNet initialization. Two confounds interact: the generator renders the low-conductivity phase with the opposite contrast polarity, and the exponential moving average (EMA; decay 0.995, no bias correction) still holds 16% of the init

translated_title: 小预算下的权重平均混淆了微观组织-性能回归中的公式标注预训练：一项带事后复核的预设定研究
translated_abstract: 闭式物理公式可以零成本地为合成微观组织提供标注，因此在标签稀缺时，基于这些标签的有监督预训练可作为自监督预训练的替代方案。本研究通过一项预设协议在两个公开模拟基准——两相材料导电率与短纤维刚度——上检验了这一思路：以ConvNeXt-Small为骨干，在150,000张合成图像上通过公式回归或掩码重建进行预训练，再分别在100、400或1,600个真实标签上进行微调。源自同一公式预训练检查点的五个微调随机种子平均残差相关性为0.994（导电率）和0.999（刚度）。在导电率任务上，公式预训练网络出现预测压缩（斜率0.64），其400标签误差达到ImageNet初始化的四倍。两个混杂因素相互作用：生成器以相反的对比极性渲染低电导率相，而指数移动平均（EMA；衰减系数0.995，无偏差修正）仍保留了16%的初始权重。
tldr: 该预设定研究发现，在小标签预算下，合成生成器对比极性反转与未做偏差修正的EMA权重平均（仍保留16%初始权重）两个混杂因素共同作用，导致公式标注预训练在微观组织-性能回归中反而显著劣于ImageNet初始化。
en_tdlr: This pre-specified study reveals that at small label budgets, two interacting confounds—an inverted contrast polarity in the synthetic generator and a bias-uncorrected EMA weight average retaining 16% of the initialization—cause formula-labeled pretraining to substantially underperform ImageNet initialization in microstructure-property regression.
